effect_entries.effect: At any time after the first Poké Ball is thrown and fails to catch a Pokémon, at the end of a turn, if a Pokémon with Ball Fetch is on the field and not holding another item, it will pick up the same type of ball as the first one thrown.
effect_entries.short_effect: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
